steps.name: An Unsettling Sign
steps.objective: Defeat "Innocent Wrigglers" and "General Ants" in the "Sunset Forest", then report to [Agent Usher] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Ah! You've come, adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Detective Xenon asked me to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has something bad happened here?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I can't say for certain yet, but...

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Something is happening to the forest's ecosystem.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It seems like an ominous sign...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must be more than you can handle on your own, Usher.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: That's why I asked for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you want me to investigate the forest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if I can find out what's causing the changes, even better...?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I do have a suspicion, but nothing certain...

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: In any case, please investigate.

steps.name: Spreading Contamination (1)
steps.objective: Defeat "Innocent Wrigglers", "Ruthless Trenches", and "Rainbow Psyches" in the "Sunset Forest", then report to [Agent Usher] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Actually, we're investigating sites around the world at the request of the Jiendia imperial court.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Dimensional rifts have been opening unpredictably, and they asked us to find the cause.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dimensional rifts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could this have something to do with Iris?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: That does seem likely.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: They appear to connect to the demon realm, or perhaps another world...

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It certainly can't be anywhere good.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: The energy leaking through the rifts is changing our ecosystem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's happening to Iris...?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Pardon? What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, now that I understand the situation...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll head back in and investigate thoroughly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is personal now.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: One thing we've discovered...

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Is that the strongest creature in each corrupted area has taken control of the area around the dimensional rift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To keep all the energy for itself?

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Yes. The energy may be tainted, but absorbing it does make them stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll head back into the forest.

steps.name: Spreading Contamination (2)
steps.objective: Defeat the "Mutant Flower Snake" in the "Sunset Forest", then report to [Agent Usher] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It really is just a narrow rift, so it will be difficult to spot.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Try looking for the strongest monster, or one that has undergone an abnormal mutation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been looking, but it's not easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I feel like I'll find something if I search a little longer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay here, Usher.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go back in and keep searching until I find something.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: All right. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I'm so glad you returned safely.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I was worried. I waited and waited, but there was no word from you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't in any danger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did find and defeat an abnormal monster, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Somehow, I never saw the rift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I got rid of everything that looked dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take someone who can perform purification rites and search the area.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: I see. Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: It must have been a difficult request...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a bit of a warm-up... Anyway, I have business elsewhere, so I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Contact me anytime if there's a problem.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: We're in your debt again.

lines.speaker: 에이전트 어셔
lines.text: Take care of yourself until we meet again.
